messages.body:
[cid:d57b684e-bc7e-4a85-a1d4-e9d7492a08ad]
Hello all
Any inputs on how to troubleshoot this error? I did a checkstructure run on the minimized pdb file and I do not see cpptraj spitting out any issues there? Any guidance on where to look and what to look for?
This is when I am heating the system keeping the protein backbone and ligand restrained in the pocket.
Debarati

messages.author: Carlos Simmerling
messages.body:
try single CPU, not MPI. it tends to give more info. also set ntpr=1 if you
didn't already. the numbers here suggest atoms 8878 and 8879, but that
might be a symptom if there are earlier warnings.
